interpretation: Qualified adaptive representations are small in raw array payload, averaging about 4.64 kB in this synthetic four-family perturbation set.
Even 10000 unique representations project to roughly 46-55 MB of array payload, excluding fixed metadata and allocator overhead.
One-time build cost is around 1.25 ms per unique representation, making repeated uncached rebuilding materially more expensive than retaining representations.
nonclaims: Synthetic perturbations are not a measured national soil distribution.
No application speedup is inferred directly from memory characterization.
